what: stage-0 golden pins of MXtalTools behaviour; README.md says how to read and regenerate them

F1.description: 4 Z'=1 csd_fd_v5 rows (C1 molecules; PYRAZB21 phenacetin sg14, YIRLEU sg2, OYIQIX sg9, HIFQUJ sg14), body frame, so both std_orientation values reproduce the crystal

F3.description: 2 Z'=2 rows of the ingestion chain (r2 store, status ok, per-unit conformers, mixed handedness; AHUMIZ sg2, AFEVOA sg14) via from_arrays; posed atoms, so std_orientation=True only

F3b.description: 2 identical-copy Z'=2 rows (zp_doubling.double_zp1_crystal of the two sg14 F1 rows, the layout the crystal search makes). std_orientation=True reproduces both parents; False reproduces HIFQUJ (handedness +1) but not PYRAZB21, whose doubled units have handedness -1 that a False build ignores (audit #30): that row's False pins are the builder's own behaviour, not the crystal

F4a.description: mixed batch at max_z_prime=2: phenacetin Z'=1 (collate-padded slot) then AFEVOA Z'=2 (list constructor)

F4b.description: as F4a with the Z'=1 row padded by the constructor (centroid 0, orientation 1, handedness 1)

two_eth_meth.description: ethanol (9) + methane (5) at Z'=2, sg 2 (audit probe P5): split 7 + 7 until stage 2, refused since (its unit map holds units of 9 and 5 atoms; #1)

two_eth_prop.description: ethanol (9) + propane (11) at Z'=2, sg 2 (two_eth_meth's cell and slots; >= 3 heavy atoms per unit, so each unit's frame is defined): split 10 + 10 until stage 2, refused since (units of 9 and 11 atoms; #1)

two_eth_ether.description: ethanol + dimethyl ether at Z'=2, sg 2 (audit probe P4): equal counts, 4 of 36 MLIP unit-cell elements wrong today (#15)

two_pyr_flb.description: 2-pyridone + fluorobenzene at Z'=2, sg 14 (audit probe2 a): equal counts, 8 of 96 MLIP unit-cell elements wrong today (#15)

group_descriptions.box: the constructed batch: per-row sums (radius, mass, mol_volume, num_atoms), symmetry, cell, box_analysis (T_fc, T_cf, cell_volume, packing_coeff, density), pose slots and atoms; where the constructor ran no box_analysis (from_arrays), box_analysis on a clone too
group_descriptions.canonicalize: canonicalize_zp_aunits() on a clone: slot order (centroid, orientation, handedness) and the atom blocks moved with it (pos, z, x, mol_ind, unit_* per-slot values, unit_smiles)
group_descriptions.latent: latent_params(gauge_fix_free_axes=g) on a clone (latents and the canonicalised state it leaves), then latent_to_cell_params(latents) on a copy (cell, pose, box)
group_descriptions.ucell: mol2ucell(std_orientation=s) on a clone: posed pos, unit_cell_pos / batch / mol_ind, z
group_descriptions.cluster: mol2cluster(cutoff, std_orientation=s) (pos, z, x, aux_ind, mol_ind, ptr, batch, unit cell) and construct_radial_graph(cutoff): intra and inter edge sets sorted (target-major), per-graph counts, inter distances in raw edge order
group_descriptions.analyze: analyze(['reduction_en', 'elj'], cutoff, std_orientation=s) on a clone
group_descriptions.rdf: analyze(['rdf'], cutoff, std_orientation=s, rdf_mode=m) on a clone: rdf, bin positions, channel labels
group_descriptions.mlip: MLIP input assembly without a model: batch_to_fairchem_batch (after mol2ucell, and force_rebuild), the list path collated, batch_to_mace_input_dict and the collated batch_to_mace_atomicdata (stub with r_max 6.0, elements 1-100); analyze([uma]) / analyze([mace]) and, on the cluster, analyze(['elj', uma|mace], cutoff 6) with stub predictors that return charlib.stub_energy of their input (the result, the stored *_pot / *_gas_pot, and every input handed over, gas leg then crystal leg; the UMA stub asks for the external graph at cutoff 6.0); ase unit-cell assembly
group_descriptions.reduction: analyze(['reduction_en']) on every row under cell variants and space groups off the reduced setting
group_descriptions.helpers: subsample_new_batch([1, 0]) and ([0]), append_batch(clone), batch_to_list and its re-collation: every key and the _slice_dict / _inc_dict entries
group_descriptions.zp_doubling: zp_doubling: double_zp1_crystal of each sg 14 F1 row (params, doubled crystal); _unit_cell_frac of each F3b row
group_descriptions.stdcell: compute_standard_cell() on a clone (spglib): cell, pose, pos, unit cell, operators, or the exception
group_descriptions.reparam: mol2ucell(std_orientation=True) then reparameterize_unit_cell() on a clone: its five outputs
group_descriptions.ingest: the F3 rows as bare deposited sets (wrapped, units interleaved, unit 1 reversed) through find_molecules, parameterize_pose and check_rebuild (csd_v1 recipe arguments, bonds by distance): every key after each step
group_descriptions.exp6: analyze(['exp6'], cutoff, std_orientation=s) on a clone
group_descriptions.split: split_to_zp1_batch() on a clone: the per-unit graphs (atoms, slots, row sums)
group_descriptions.elements: per MLIP input builder and the ase unit-cell assembly: elements and positions per crystal, and the number of rows whose element differs from the geometric truth (charlib.element_truth)
